name: emit a conflict report with per-user field diffs and chosen value
definition: produce a structured report listing every user+field variance, the contributing source values, the winner, and a total count consistent with the list length.
failure_mode: missing a real conflict or inconsistent counts fails the report structure assertions

name: emit alert and report json with the required schemas
definition: Produce a summary alert json (timestamp plus alerts with id/severity/matches/ips) and a report json (events plus a statistics map of per-rule counts).
failure_mode: missing keys or invalid json fails the schema checks
